paragraphs: Dwarpaal sells hotel technology packaged as SmartHotel-in-a-Box, built for budget and midscale hospitality rather than luxury chains. The package is pitched as improving revenue per available room, operational efficiency and guest experience without a costly overhaul.

The platform ties together access control, energy automation, operations and guest engagement instead of selling each as a separate fix. Guests skip the front desk queue through keyless entry and self check-in. Thermostats, lighting and room settings respond automatically to guest and room status to bring energy costs down. Lock battery levels are tracked in the cloud so replacements happen before a failure. Automated housekeeping audit logs record every cleaning task. The company says no rip and replace is required and that the platform works with the systems a hotel already runs.

Mid-sized hotel groups are one of the audiences the site names. Sudhanshu Patki is identified as chief executive. Leadership bios cite IoT deployments across three countries. Case studies on the site cover access control work at hotel properties.

quote.text: No rip-and-replace required. Dwarpaal works with the systems you already run.
